newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil soybean plantings to Oct 31 by state - Safras.
newsitem.headline: Brazil soybean plantings to Oct 31 by state - Safras.

text.p: Brazilian soybean plantings of the 1996/97 crop by October 31 per state as estimated by consultants Safras e Mercado are as follows in percentage terms.

RIO GRANDE DO SUL- Mostly sunny weather in the past week has permitted final soil preparation and the start of planting. Expectations of higher planted area depspite credit problems PARANA - Very good progress with the improvement of weather helping plantings to surpass historical average. Good, well-distributed rains giving rise to hopes of good productivity MATO GROSSO - Almost daily rains are keeping soil moisture levels high but preventing regular planting. Accelerated plantings however in the center-north of the state MATO GROSSO DO SUL - Good and regular showers throughout the state favoring soil moisture levels but inhibiting a little the pace of plantings. Main problem is lack of resources GOIAS - As rains came early this year, the state is the most advanced in plantings compared with historical average. Areas not planted in 1995 are likely to be used again this year SAO PAULO - Good progress with favorable and well-distributed rains. Planted area should stay at the same levels or grow a little. MINAS GERAIS - Last week's rains were regarded as insufficient for the real beginning of planting.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
